items.definition:
shrewd and well-informed; having practical knowledge or understanding
He's very tech-savvy and can fix any computer problem.

existing or occurring on the surface; not thorough or deep
He only has a superficial understanding of the topic.

showing quick and inventive verbal humor
She gave a witty response that made everyone laugh.

feeling or showing sympathy and concern for others
She is a compassionate nurse who always cares for her patients.

harmful; damaging
Smoking is detrimental to your health.

relating to a doctorate
She is currently pursuing her doctoral studies.

lacking fear
The fearless knight charged into battle.

(of vegetation) growing luxuriantly
The rainforest was full of lush green plants.

extremely comfortable, elegant, or enjoyable, especially in a way that involves great expense
They stayed in a luxurious hotel suite.

relating to a minister of state or a religious minister
The ministerial meeting will discuss new policies.

relating to mysticism or spiritual mystery
The ancient ruins had a mystical aura about them.

full of energy and enthusiasm
She gave a spirited performance on stage.

serving to describe or characterize
The author used very descriptive language in her novel.

best or most favorable
For optimum performance, the machine needs regular maintenance.

showing a response to a stimulus
The company's approach to customer complaints is often reactive rather than proactive.

limiting or controlling someone or something
The new rules are too restrictive.

not realistic
His expectations were completely unrealistic.

according to custom or usual practice
It is customary to tip the waiter in this country.

too small or unimportant to be worth consideration
His contribution to the project was insignificant.

well informed; intelligent
She is very knowledgeable about ancient history.

having healing properties
Many herbs have medicinal uses.

relating to the medical care of children
She works as a pediatric nurse at the hospital.

having peculiar or unexpected traits
She has a quirky sense of humor that makes everyone laugh.

of or prompted by feelings of tenderness, sadness, or nostalgia
She kept the old teddy bear for sentimental reasons.

occurring or operating at the same time
There were simultaneous broadcasts of the event on different channels.

not able to be relied upon
The old car proved to be very unreliable.

cheerful and optimistic
Despite the challenges, she remained upbeat about the future.

polite and well-mannered; advanced in social development
We should try to have a civilized discussion about this issue.

situated at the front
The fore part of the ship was damaged.

full of hate or deserving hate
His hateful comments offended everyone.

dull and flat, without a shine
The paint had a matte finish.

of average or low quality
The restaurant served mediocre food, nothing special.

relating to Scandinavia, Finland, and Iceland
She loves Nordic design, especially the minimalist furniture.

causing great public interest and excitement
The singer gave a sensational performance last night.

acting in a stealthy or underhand way
The cat made a sneaky attempt to steal food from the table.

having sharp angles or a gaunt, bony appearance
The modern sculpture had a very angular design.

Impertinent or irreverent in an amusing way.
The child gave a cheeky grin.

relating to instruction or teaching
The video provides clear instructional guidance.

employing or involving modules as the basis of a design or construction
The new furniture has a modular design, allowing for flexible arrangements.

based on conjecture rather than knowledge
His theory was highly speculative and lacked concrete evidence.

able to be relied on as honest or truthful
He is a trustworthy person; you can rely on his word.

conducive to moral or physical well-being
She prefers wholesome food like fresh fruits and vegetables.

having or showing a keen interest in or enthusiasm for something
She is an avid reader of historical novels.

unconventional, especially in artistic or literary circles
She lived a bohemian lifestyle, traveling and creating art.

relating to a bride or a wedding
She wore a beautiful bridal gown.

without any knowledge or understanding
He was completely clueless about what to do next.

of very poor quality; unpleasant
I had a really crappy day at work.

full of glamour; attractive and exciting
She leads a very glamorous lifestyle.

rear; back
The dog's hind legs were injured.

lacking experience
The new employee was very inexperienced.

relating to the Jurassic period
Dinosaurs lived during the Jurassic period.

having legs (often used in compounds)
The table was three-legged and unstable.

payable
The invoice is payable within 30 days.

preventive
Preventive measures were taken to avoid the spread of the disease.

radical, excellent
That concert was totally rad!

resilient
She is very resilient in the face of adversity.

boring and too long
The work was tedious and repetitive.

relating to plants or botany
The botanical garden has a wide variety of plants.

relating to a ceremony
The queen wore her ceremonial robes.

in a worse position
The program helps disadvantaged children.

relating to gravity
The moon's gravitational pull affects the tides.

Conscious or aware of something.
It's important to be mindful of your surroundings.

Relating to sailors, ships, or navigation.
The museum displayed many nautical instruments.

Worthy of attention or notice; remarkable.
Her achievements are truly noteworthy.
